info.title: Flyerrr API
info.description:
HTTP API for accounts, events, organizations and bookmarks. This file is the contract: `server/openapi.test.ts` fails when a route in `server/app.ts` is missing from it, or documented here but not served.

Every route except `/api/health` and `/api/auth/*` needs the session cookie. Every write (anything but GET, HEAD and OPTIONS) must send an `Origin` header matching the server's `APP_ORIGIN`, or it gets 403. Unknown `/api` paths return 404 with `{ "error": "Endpoint not found." }`. A request body over 12 MB returns 413; invalid JSON returns 400.

sessionCookie.name: flyerrr_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie set by register and login. Valid for 7 days.

fields.description: Messages per field name (validation failures only).

Session.description: When `isLoggedIn` is false only `role` (student) and an empty `userName` are present.

password.description: Needs a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a number.

avatar.description: The first two letters of the name, uppercased.

myRole.description: The caller's role, or null for a non-member.

handle.description: A leading @ is accepted and removed. Unique ignoring case.

date.description: Local calendar date shown to people.

startsAt.description: The same moment as `date` and `time` in `timezone`, with an offset. Must be in the future.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, such as America/New_York.

capacity.description: Whole number from 1 to 10,000. Defaults to 100 when empty.

tags.description: Tag names, as an array or one comma-separated string.

image.description: An https URL, a site-relative path, or a base64 png, jpeg or webp data URL.

organizationId.description: The organization to publish for. The caller must lead it. Optional; see the operation description.

saved.description: Whether the caller has saved this event.
